'''Davim Cross''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] for both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the father of [[Jahan Cross|Jahan]] and [[Jens Cross]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he worked for the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he served as the main Imperial negotiator on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], representing [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] in the [[Dooku regency conclave|dispute]] for who among the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]] would serve as [[Regent/Legends|regent]] for [[Bron Dooku]].
